messages:
alex: Quick follow-up on the Accept-Version deprecation RFC — thinking about safe rollout and what proxies/shims should do. TL;DR: prefer header negotiation + soft fallback. Thoughts?
maria: +1. We need visibility first. Emit telemetry when a fallback happens and when a shim maps fields. Propose `x-rw-client-version` probe header and `x-rw-fallback-reason` metric. Start with tiny canary. :eyes:
ken: Who owns the proxy shim? If edge-proxy inserts transforms we need clear rollback ownership. Also watch CPU on hot paths — some proxies add ~0.6ms/request.
alex: Good Q. Ownership: edge-proxy team for runtime opt-in shims; platform for global opt-in. Rollback plan in runbook. Phases: 1) probe + telemetry, 2) opt-in cohorts (5/20/100), 3) global opt-in then remove legacy support after 90d.
maria: Add automated gate: if p99 latency delta > 50ms for cohort, circuit-break shim and alert. Tag requests with `fallback=true` so traces filter. Also capture `compat.map_count` counter for mapping volume.
ken: Some clients also change payload shape (e.g., `instructions` -> `guide`). Shim can map keys but must emit a sampled mapping log with a histogram. We should avoid full reserialization in fast path.
alex: Example probe call we'll use in canary:```curl -H 'Accept-Version: v2' -H 'X-RW-Probe: 1' https://api.redwood.ai/generate``` We will log `compat.probe.accept_version` with {result:ok|fallback|error}.
sre-bot: Deploy started to edge-proxy-canary (5%) by @deploy-bot :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary rolled to 5%. Running 5m smoke: no error spike, 1.2% map_count on cohort.
maria: I'll add an Optimize eval checklist: semantic regression prompts + `generated_text_diff` alert if >0.5% regressions. Also publish telemetry schema to obs.
alex: I'll draft the runbook + telemetry schema doc today and tag owners. Ping me if you want to be in the 5% cohort.
ken: ack :+1:
